blocking.title: G12 and make review accept a reviewed tree from which files were moved into artifacts/review/
blocking.evidence: Both compute the drift since the review with `git diff --name-only <reviewed> HEAD`. Git detects renames by default, and for a rename --name-only prints only the destination path, so moving any tracked file into artifacts/review/ hides that it left its original path. I tested this on a scratch clone at d9d04b2. I committed a SHIP latest.json for d9d04b2, then committed `git mv src/evalstats/rank.py artifacts/review/rank.py` and `git mv tests/test_e2.py artifacts/review/test_e2.py`. After that, `git diff --name-only d9d04b2 HEAD` lists only artifacts/review/latest.json, artifacts/review/rank.py and artifacts/review/test_e2.py. `python3 tools/review.py --validate` ends `REVIEW: SHIP`, and `ship_check.g12` on that clone (setup_ok set, the uv prefix replaced by python3) returns `REVIEW: SHIP for d9d04b24444e`, a PASS, although src/evalstats/rank.py no longer exists. So G12 can pass while its property is false: the review does not cover the current code. The brief's rule (10.1 step 8) allows drift only in artifacts/review/, STATUS.md and docs/LOG.md. Fix in tools/ and tests/ only, which is safe while G6 runs: pass `--no-renames` to both diffs, and add a test in which a rename out of src/ makes the review stale.

non_blocking.title: G5 recounts E0 part 2 grouped GLMM cells against each raw line's own truth
non_blocking.detail: raw_covered (tools/ship_check.py:586-640) checks a grouped line's seed and stamps but takes `truth` from the line itself. Nothing compares it with the planted values that 0005's recovery-config fixes, so a simulator that wrote a wrong truth would be recounted as valid. D-039 added this check to G6 (g6_planted_truths, N6), but G5 has no counterpart. The issue is latent: no 0005 cell is banked yet.

non_blocking.title: No gate checks that stamped raw rows were produced after their preregistration froze
non_blocking.detail: G6 checks that recovery.json's first commit comes after 0006, and G5 does the same for each coverage artifact. Neither compares the rows' `stamp.at` with the `frozen_at` in prereg/CHAIN.jsonl. G11 checks only JSON artifacts that cite a prereg, and artifacts/g6/raw.jsonl and artifacts/e0/raw/*.jsonl cite none. So rows run on the preregistered seeds before the freeze would pass. Today all 123 G6 rows carry stamps from 2026-11-11T20:19:58Z onward, after 0006 froze at 04:21:42Z, with one environment (c1569b433f0f5a99), one analysis code (b6b0e09229761233) and a clean src/.
